notes.title: Don't Puke Becoming F2P
notes.notes:
After a long discussion, we've decided to make Don't Puke free to play.
 
The game was meant to be played with other people sharing the world with you - this is where it's the most fun. However the game didn't get enough traction to really populate the world, therefore we are giving it away for free to hopefully attract more people, which would improve the experience even for the players who already paid for it.

The game will be changed to free to play roughly in a week - 7/8/2024.
